# National Weather Service Forecast

> Official NOAA National Weather Service forecasting and weather information resource providing local forecasts, current conditions, hazardous weather alerts, and comprehensive weather terminology reference.

The National Weather Service (NWS), part of NOAA, delivers authoritative weather forecasts and warnings for the United States. This site provides localized forecast data, real-time weather conditions, hazard alerts, and educational resources to help the public understand weather terminology and forecasting concepts.

## Key Topics

- National Weather Service (NWS)
- NOAA
- Local Weather Forecast
- Current Conditions
- Extended Forecast
- Hazardous Weather Alerts
- Red Flag Warning
- Weather Terminology
- Forecaster Terms
- Weather Definitions
- Des Moines, Iowa
- Public Education
- Weather Glossary

## Local Forecasts

- [Des Moines, IA Local Forecast](https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=41.58981000000006&lon=-93.61537999999996): NWS local forecast for Des Moines, IA with current conditions, extended forecast, and hazardous weather alerts

## Reference & Education

- [Weather Glossary](https://forecast.weather.gov/glossary.php): NOAA National Weather Service glossary defining weather terminology, forecaster terms, and weather definitions for public education
